scope.description: ReadIndex request identity across leader-side quorum batching and follower-side ReadyToRead delivery.
assumptions: Stable term and voting membership during the requests.
Distinct nonzero SystemCtx values and known follower origins.
The leader has committed an entry in its current term.
excluded: Permanent liveness, client deadline breaches, and application read values.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: In-memory storage and synchronous transport substitute for disk and networking; no crash or persistence failure is claimed.
Contexts are supplied directly to Peer.ReadIndex; NodeHost client workers are not instantiated.
Application of non-configuration entries is represented by sequential applied-index notification; no application value claim.

plan_uncertainties: The result is local completion-identity semantics, not a stale-read safety violation or a client deadline claim.
Three subsequent heartbeat ticks are a measured continuation only, not a permanent-stalling bound.

blockers: Open review issue 80f35be38a854348bc5e39599365f455 [peer_bootstrap,peer_bootstrap_entries,read_confirmation,read_forward_consume,read_client_matching,batch_context_expectation]: Origin 3 receives its own admitted context in the same run.; The local leader completion branch uses each saved context correctly.
boundaries: Permanent liveness, client deadline breaches, and application read values.
